summary: std/json: `json.parse_value` and decoding into `json.Value` are linear in nested duplicate keys
details: `json.parse_value` and decoding into `json.Value` are linear in nested duplicate keys; each level of `{"a":0,"a":{...}}` doubled the work, so 600 bytes could hang a program.
changelog: - Security (std/json, Go backend): `json.parse_value` and decoding into `json.Value` are linear in nested duplicate keys; each level of `{"a":0,"a":{...}}` doubled the work, so 600 bytes could hang a program.
